title: wall clock
text: wall clock. White and silver wall clock... very subtle in color around 12" or so ... all plastic.  I was super disappointed to find that the clock had already been used - it was removed from the screws that attach the clock to packing box and it was just loose.  Eh.  So far it is running -  and I haven't noticed any sound.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  I really am displeased that I was sent a USED clock.
